newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA-CZECH WORLD CUP QUALIFIER POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA-CZECH WORLD CUP QUALIFIER POSTPONED.

text.p: A World Cup qualifier between Slovakia and the Czech Republic has been postponed because two Czech players are involved in the UEFA Cup final with German club Schalke, the Slovak Football Federation (SFZ) said on Tuesday.
The European group six World Cup qualifier and the second leg of the UEFA Cup final between Schalke and Inter Milan are both scheduled for May 21.

The Slovak TASR news agency said the postponement had been requested by Schalke because two of their key players -- Radoslav Latal and Jiri Nemec -- were also members of the Czech national team. Schalke take a 1-0 first-leg lead into the second leg of the final in Milan.

"FIFA (soccer's world governing body) has ruled that the qualification group six match is to be postponed and called on our two soccer federations to agree on a new date," a SFZ spokeswoman said. Normally the club would have had to release the two players for the international under FIFA rules.
She said the SFZ might propose the World Cup qualifier be held in August.
The Czechs have proposed May 29 as an alternative date, TASR said.
